summary: Stripe real-payment integration verified end-to-end. BACKEND (6/6 new + 30/31 regression passed): POST /api/billing/checkout with tier=pro returns 200 with real https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/... URL and cs_test_ session_id; payment_transactions row persisted with amount=12.0/29.0 USD, fulfilled=False, tier+user_id correct. master tier works identically. Invalid tier (bogus) -> 400 'Invalid tier'. Missing auth -> 401/403. GET /api/billing/status/{session_id} on a fresh unpaid session returns payment_status in {unpaid,open,no_payment_required}, user.credits stays at 60 (no premature fulfillment), tx.fulfilled stays False. Idempotency confirmed: when a tx is already fulfilled=True, polling /billing/status again does NOT double-credit (credits delta = 0, tier preserved). FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport on web preview): paywall redesign renders correctly — 'UNLOCK YOUR SUPERHUMAN CONTRACTOR' headline, 5-star row + 'Loved by 12,000+ confident DIYers' social proof, MOST POPULAR badge on PRO card, $12 one-time + 4 perks, GET PRO testID=paywall-select-pro, MASTER card with $29 + GET MASTER testID=paywall-select-master, trust row (Secure Stripe checkout / Cancel anytime), 'Keep exploring with my 60 free credits' link testID=paywall-start-trial, and test-card disclaimer. Tapping GET PRO triggers real cross-origin navigation to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... (verified via framenavigated listener) — window.location.href redirect works. paywall-start-trial fallback successfully navigates to /(tabs) home (URL '/'), credits remain at 60. /billing/success?session_id=... page mounts and shows 'CONFIRMING PAYMENT … Hang tight — unlocking your account…' polling state. Did not complete a real-card payment in Stripe iframe (Stripe Elements are cross-origin and out-of-scope for Playwright); the success->paid->/(tabs) leg was validated structurally via backend fulfillment + the success page polling logic. ONE FRONTEND BUG FOUND: AuthProvider intercepts the Stripe session_id query param as a Google OAuth session_id (see RCA).

minor.issue: passlib bcrypt version warning (`module 'bcrypt' has no attribute '__about__'`). Carryover, cosmetic.

integration_issues.issue: AuthProvider's mount effect in /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx:88-110 unconditionally treats ANY `session_id` query param on ANY page as a Google OAuth session_id and POSTs it to /api/auth/google, which returns 401 ('Google sign-in failed'). This fires an unhandled rejection visible on the /billing/success screen as an error overlay in dev. Token & user are preserved so the polling still works, but the bug a) prints a noisy 401 + uncaught error, b) is a real collision between Google OAuth and Stripe sharing the `session_id` convention, c) risks future side-effects if the catch-all is changed. Fix: gate the Google session check to the auth screen only, or to URLs NOT under /billing/*.

action_items: Fix AuthProvider Stripe/Google session_id collision in /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx:88-110. Recommended: only run the Google session_id consumer when the current path is '/' or '/auth*' (skip when pathname.startsWith('/billing/')). Alternatively wrap processSessionId in a try/catch that silently aborts on 401 so the Stripe success page polling proceeds cleanly without the 'Google sign-in failed' error overlay.

critical_code_review_comments: Stripe checkout server-side amount is enforced via STRIPE_PACKAGES (server.py:769) — client never sends the price. Good.
Idempotency uses payment_transactions.fulfilled flag (server.py:832) — correct guard against double-credit on repeated polling.
billing/status updates payment_status only when value changed (server.py:842) — efficient and idempotent.
paywall.tsx correctly uses Platform.OS branch: web -> window.location.href (full redirect, preserves URL params on return); native -> WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync + replace to /billing/success. Good.

/billing/success.tsx polls up to MAX_POLLS=8 at 2s = 16s window — reasonable. If user closes tab during processing, fulfillment still happens on next /billing/status call since the row is keyed by session_id.
FRONTEND BUG (NEW): auth.tsx:88-110 will fire /auth/google with ANY session_id query on app mount, including Stripe's. See RCA section.

To verify the end-to-end paid->credits-560 path, EITHER (a) manually pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242 in a browser, OR (b) directly stub payment by setting tx.fulfilled=False AND mocking Stripe's get_checkout_status to return payment_status='paid' (the fulfillment branch in server.py:832 will then run and bump credits by +500/+2000). The frontend AuthProvider Stripe-vs-Google session_id collision (auth.tsx:88) MUST be fixed before the paid->/(tabs) leg can be tested cleanly — otherwise the /billing/success page momentarily displays a 'Google sign-in failed' error overlay in dev/preview.
